description: Use when the user asks if there is a broadband outage right now without naming a provider, or wants the current status of UK broadband providers. Returns the FindBroadband hub's own board: every provider we track with its status (Down, Issues earlier or Working fine), where the problem is when the provider named a place, the hub's headline and a link to each provider's page. Down includes incidents limited to the places named, so always say where. For one provider in detail use get_provider_outage_status.
name: get_outage_overview
title: Current UK broadband outages
